Your responsibilities include: - Developing and improving applications within the Thinkwise platform - Building and maintaining integrations between internal and external systems - Developing APIs and data interfaces - Optimizing business processes through automation - Working with SQL Server databases and business-critical data - Collaborating with colleagues across purchasing, logistics, finance, and sales - Testing, troubleshooting, and improving existing applications and integrations - Translating business requirements into practical software solutions - Contributing to the continuous improvement of our application landscape - Documenting technical solutions, data structures, application logic, and development decisions. 
You will primarily work with the Thinkwise Platform, SQL Server, and .NET technologies. Experience with Thinkwise is welcome but not required; we are happy to support experienced developers in learning the platform. 
 Who are you? 
We are looking for a developer who combines technical expertise with an interest in business processes. You are available to work 32-40 hours per week on-site at our office. Please note that this is a fully office-based role; hybrid or remote working is not available. 
You have: - 3-5 years of experience in software development - Experience with .NET and C# - Strong knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server and T-SQL - Experience with APIs and system integrations - Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment - Good communication skills in English
